evidence.title: DesignSystems.one | Design Systems, Explained — Gallery, Guides & Tools

name: DesignSystems.one
summary: Catalogue of 120 real-world design systems with breakdowns, an agent-readiness index and free token and accessibility tools.
description: Practitioner-run catalogue of real design systems (Polaris, Carbon, Material 3, Apple HIG, Primer, shadcn/ui and more) with editorial breakdowns, token snapshots, cross-system patterns and watch-outs. Adds the Agent-Ready Design Systems Index (37 systems scored on MCP, llms.txt, DTCG tokens, registry and Figma Code Connect), an 8-chapter build playbook, foundation guides and ten SKILL.md files. JSON APIs, a shadcn registry and an MCP server expose the data; free browser tools generate tokens, check accessibility and lay out grids.
contains: 120 real-world design systems in the gallery, 49 with rich breakdowns
Agent-Ready Index: 37 systems scored on 5 signals, data CC BY 4.0
12 cross-system patterns: forms, tables, confirmations, empty states
shadcn registry items: utils, button, input, card
JSON APIs and an MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth)
free browser tools: token generator, grid builder, accessibility checker, ROI calculator
